messages:
alex: Heads-up — deploy-bot pushed a tag `v1.8.12-ci.45` for a config-only infra tweak. Question: do we want deploy-bot to create ci/prerelease tags for infra/config-only changes or just bump patch (v1.8.13) and add buildmeta? worried about downstream pinning and noise in release notes. cc @jamie @olga

jamie: lean toward patch with buildmeta. most downstream consumers treat semver patch as safe. if we leave a CI prerelease it can confuse pinning, e.g. `^1.8.12` won't pull `1.8.12-ci.45`.

olga: agreed. also for release-notes: config-only should be omitted unless it affects customer-facing behavior. release-bot should only pick up changelog entries with the `user-facing` label.

mike: practical question: how do we represent the buildmeta? `v1.8.13+ci.45` or `v1.8.13-ci.45`? buildmeta is valid per semver after `+` and is ignored by semver comparisons.

jamie: prefer `+ci12345` (no dots) so packaging systems don't treat it as a different prerelease. example: `v1.8.13+ci45`. keeps `v1.8.13` as the canonical semver.

alex: quick counter: some registries and our internal pinning scripts strip `+` metadata. if that's unreliable we should have a canonical lightweight tag that everyone understands. maybe auto-create both `v1.8.13` (annotated) and `v1.8.13+ci45`?

deploy-bot: automated: created annotated tag `v1.8.12-ci.45` and pushed to origin. trigger: infra/helm-values tweak. CI run: 2024-11-01T18:12:37Z.

olga: if deploy-bot can auto-convert to `v1.8.13` on merge with `chore: infra` label, that would be ideal. otherwise it's noisy. we should add a rule: config-only changes => patch bump + buildmeta, and release-bot excludes them from changelog unless `release-note: include` is present.

mike: rollback policy: if we do automatic patch bumps for infra-only, can we auto-roll them back after a failed canary? i'd suggest 20-minute canary window + automatic rollback on error rate spike > 3x baseline or >=5% absolute.

jamie: agree on 20m. also add a human-in-loop flag for infra pushes that touch runtime images — require manual confirmation for image pins.

alex: proposal summary: 1) deploy-bot should canonicalize tags to `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` and append `+ciN` buildmeta for traceability; 2) config-only changes default to patch; 3) release-bot filters out config-only by default; 4) canary window 20m + rollback heuristics as mike suggested; 5) if any consumer pins to exact `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-ci.*` that's encouraged to be changed to exact base `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`.

olga: tiny add — regex for tags we accept in release tooling: `^v(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)(?:\\+ci(\\d+))?$` — keeps it simple.

mike: also document examples in ops/semver-guidelines.md and update the deploy-bot config: `bump_strategy: patch_for_labels: [chore:infra, config] buildmeta_template: "+ci{run_id}" create_canonical_tag: true`

alex: sounds good. can someone file the tiny RFC and update deploy-bot config? i'll do the RFC if jamie or olga can PR the deploy-bot changes.

jamie: i'll take the deploy-bot PR tomorrow morning.

olga: i'll draft the RFC with examples and release-notes filtering rules.

release-bot: automated: noted — will skip changelog entries for commits tagged `chore/infra` unless `release-note: include` present.

alex: thanks all. i'll follow up after PRs land. :thumbsup:
